description: P-51D Mustang 1/4 scale, 120 cc class (plans/short-kit class: Chad Veich 1/4 plans, Jerry Bates 1/4, FokkeRC 1/4 short kit): 2.820 m span giant-scale P-51D Mustang, 120 cc gasoline. EXPERIMENTAL first physics estimate (P51-05), generated by research/p51/p51-05/derive_physics.py from full-size dimensions scaled to the kit; not flight-identified. Flaps and retracts are not simulated (gear DOWN drag). Visual geometry lives in assets/aircraft/p51d-mustang-120/geometry.json.

frames.le_frame: positions in metres from the wing leading edge at the centreline (model z 0): [x_aft, y_right, z_up]; z = 0 on the thrust line (spinner axis)
frames.body: simulation body axes FRD about the CG: x forward = -x_aft, y right, z down = -z_up

wing_area.source: research/p51/p51-05/derive_physics.py: trapezoid span x (root + tip) / 2 from assets/aircraft/p51d-mustang-120/geometry.json (P51-01: full-size P-51D dimensions scaled to the kit span)

wing_span.source: kit span, P-51D Mustang 1/4 scale, 120 cc class (plans/short-kit class: Chad Veich 1/4 plans, Jerry Bates 1/4, FokkeRC 1/4 short kit) (source.json)

mean_chord.source: S / b: the v1 coefficient reference length. NOT the MAC (0.5087 m at 0.6181 m span)

root_chord.source: 104 in full-size root chord x scale, assets/aircraft/p51d-mustang-120/geometry.json (P51-01: full-size P-51D dimensions scaled to the kit span)

tip_chord.source: 50 in full-size tip chord x scale, assets/aircraft/p51d-mustang-120/geometry.json (P51-01: full-size P-51D dimensions scaled to the kit span)

aero_reference_point.source: research/p51/p51-05/derive_physics.py: wing-body aerodynamic centre: 25 % MAC moved forward by the fuselage (Raymer K_fus); on the wing chord plane

level_speed.source: research/p51/p51-05/derive_physics.py: 1.6 x the 1-g stall at the flight mass and CL_max, rounded

plan_cg.source: 27 % MAC (kit placeholder, source.json) = model z 0.1778; z from the inventory (derived)

firewall.source: the model's engine-box firewall: spinner back + 0.25 m (a 120 cc twin on standoffs); the scaled full-size firewall is only the cowl split

cg_tolerance.source: research/p51/p51-05/derive_physics.py: virtual reference build balanced to the kit's point, NOT a measured airplane

mass.source: DA-120: 2300 g engine, 2445 g with ignition (toni-clark.com/en/da-120); DLE-120 2.78-2.90 kg complete

position.source: crankshaft on the thrust line, crankcase ~0.13 m behind the spinner back

fuselage rear and turtle deck, covered

crash_hull.source: Points that hit the ground first (le frame) from assets/aircraft/p51d-mustang-120/geometry.json (P51-01: full-size P-51D dimensions scaled to the kit span): wing tip LE/TE (with dihedral), spinner tip, main wheel bottoms, tail wheel bottom, rudder bottom TE, stab tips, fin top, canopy top, scoop bottom. Replaced by gear contact in E1/E2

mass_range.source: kit flying mass range 18.0-24.0 kg (source.json; CARF 2.54 m: 15-17 kg dry), widened for fuel and the virtual balancing mass of the reference build

inertia_reference.source: UltraStick25e Jxx Jyy Jzz (1.959 kg, 1.27 m span); compared after scaling by m·b²

aileron.source: asin(kit mm / local chord): Hangar 9 HAN4770 high rates (aileron 22 mm up, elevator 25 mm, rudder 55 mm) scaled by span 2.82/2.26 = 1.25; CARF (2.54 m) high rate: aileron 12.7 mm, elevator 19 mm up, rudder 51 mm

elevator.source: asin(kit mm / local chord): Hangar 9 HAN4770 high rates (aileron 22 mm up, elevator 25 mm, rudder 55 mm) scaled by span 2.82/2.26 = 1.25; CARF (2.54 m) high rate: aileron 12.7 mm, elevator 19 mm up, rudder 51 mm

rudder.source: asin(kit mm / local chord): Hangar 9 HAN4770 high rates (aileron 22 mm up, elevator 25 mm, rudder 55 mm) scaled by span 2.82/2.26 = 1.25; CARF (2.54 m) high rate: aileron 12.7 mm, elevator 19 mm up, rudder 51 mm

servo_full_throw_time.source: giant-scale high-torque servos: 0.15-0.20 s per 60 deg at 6-7 V

aero.source: Derived from the scaled geometry by research/p51/p51-05/derive_physics.py (Helmbold/DATCOM, tail volume, strip theory, drag build-up); report research/p51/p51-05/derivation.md. Not flight-identified: EXPERIMENTAL.

CL_max.source: 15 % laminar section clmax ~1.3 at Re 7e5 x 0.9 for the wing, flaps up; no polar identified

CL_min.source: cambered section: inverted stall earlier than upright

stall_blend_width.source: laminar section with a sharper break than the Stik's 6 deg; tip-stall tendency of the real airplane is not modelled beyond the equal-area strips

sideslip_blend.source: Sideslip range where the linear beta terms (CYb, Clb, Cnb) give way to their sin(beta) form, finite and restoring up to knife edge

conventions.rates: p_hat = p·b/(2V), q_hat = q·c/(2V), r_hat = r·b/(2V)
conventions.elevator: per radian, positive = trailing edge DOWN (dCm/dElev < 0)
conventions.aileron: per radian per surface, positive = trailing edge DOWN; right and left listed separately
conventions.rudder: per radian, positive = trailing edge LEFT (dCn/dRud < 0)
conventions.axes: lift, drag, side force in wind axes; roll, pitch, yaw moments in body axes about the aero reference point

CL0.source: research/p51/p51-05/derive_physics.py: cambered wing at +1 deg incidence + tail at zero body alpha

CLa.source: research/p51/p51-05/derive_physics.py: Helmbold wing x cos2(dihedral) + downwashed tail

CLadot.source: research/p51/p51-05/derive_physics.py: 2 eta CLa_h Sh/S l_h/c deps/dalpha

CLq.source: research/p51/p51-05/derive_physics.py: tail volume + DATCOM wing term

CLde.source: research/p51/p51-05/derive_physics.py: tail slope x elevator effectiveness

CLda_each.source: research/p51/p51-05/derive_physics.py: strip theory over the aileron span

CD0.source: research/p51/p51-05/derive_physics.py: component drag build-up at 22 m/s with the gear DOWN (retracts not simulated), see derivation.md

CL_minD.source: cambered laminar section: minimum drag near half the zero-alpha wing lift

CDda_each.source: OpenFlightSim UltraStick25e (via the Stik data file); second-order control drag

CDdr.source: OpenFlightSim UltraStick25e (via the Stik data file); second-order control drag

CDde.source: OpenFlightSim UltraStick25e (via the Stik data file); second-order control drag

CYdr.source: research/p51/p51-05/derive_physics.py: fin slope x Sv/S x rudder effectiveness (must equal the vertical surface)

Clb.source: research/p51/p51-05/derive_physics.py: 5 deg dihedral (strip theory) + wing at CL_ref + low-wing interference + fin

Clp.source: research/p51/p51-05/derive_physics.py: strip theory with taper + stab + fin

Cldr.source: research/p51/p51-05/derive_physics.py: rudder side force x fin height above the ARP

Cm0.source: research/p51/p51-05/derive_physics.py: wing Cm_ac (parabolic camber) + tail at zero body alpha, about the ARP

Cma.source: research/p51/p51-05/derive_physics.py: tail about the wing-body ac; the CG transfer gives the static margin

Cmq.source: research/p51/p51-05/derive_physics.py: tail damping about the CG (undownwashed tail slope) x1.1 for wing/fuselage

Cmde.source: research/p51/p51-05/derive_physics.py: elevator lift x tail arm from the ARP

Cmda_each.source: research/p51/p51-05/derive_physics.py: aileron lift increment at its thin-airfoil centre, arm from the ARP

Cnb.source: research/p51/p51-05/derive_physics.py: fin only (v1 contract: equals the vertical surface)

Cnr.source: research/p51/p51-05/derive_physics.py: fin + wing profile drag + fuselage (-0.02 estimated)

Cnda_right.source: research/p51/p51-05/derive_physics.py: adverse yaw 2 K CL_ref Clda, K 0.15 (Nelson, AR 5.8, taper 0.48)

Cndr.source: research/p51/p51-05/derive_physics.py: rudder side force x fin arm from the ARP (must equal the vertical surface)

wing_aileron_effectiveness.source: research/p51/p51-05/derive_physics.py: |Clda_right| 2n b / (CLa sum(y)) over the loader's equal-area tapered strips

attached_limit.source: same provisional value as the Ugly Stik surface model (retained small-angle oracle validity limit)

tail_local_limit.source: same provisional value as the Ugly Stik surface model (complete local loads before tail stall)

tail_CD0.source: same provisional value as the Ugly Stik surface model (estimated, not measured flight data)

tail_k.source: same provisional value as the Ugly Stik surface model (estimated, not measured flight data)

tail_CD90.source: same provisional value as the Ugly Stik surface model (same flat-plate approximation as wing)

area.source: research/p51/p51-05/derive_physics.py: stab + elevator trapezoid from assets/aircraft/p51d-mustang-120/geometry.json (P51-01: full-size P-51D dimensions scaled to the kit span)

area.source: research/p51/p51-05/derive_physics.py: fin + rudder side polygon from assets/aircraft/p51d-mustang-120/geometry.json (P51-01: full-size P-51D dimensions scaled to the kit span)

position.source: research/p51/p51-05/derive_physics.py: fin ac: quarter chord at the area-centroid height

propulsion.description: 120 cc gasoline twin turning a 4-blade 26x12: blade-element/momentum tables computed by research/p51/p51-05/derive_physics.py (no measured table for this propeller); static rpm where the propeller power meets an estimated flat-torque engine curve. AXIAL thrust.

engine.name: Desert Aircraft DA-120 (121 cc twin, 2.45 kg with ignition) or DLE-120

peak_power.source: DA-120 11.7 hp, desertaircraft.com/products/da-120 (2026-10-06); DLE-120 12 hp at 7500 rpm (DLE manual)

peak_power_rpm.source: DA-120 top of the 1300-6900 rpm range (desertaircraft.com)

max_rpm_static.source: research/p51/p51-05/derive_physics.py: BEM Cp0 meets the engine power curve P(n) = P_peak (n/n_peak)(2 - n/n_peak)

idle_rpm.source: DA-120 range starts at 1300 rpm (desertaircraft.com); DLE-120 idle 1300 (manual)

lag_time_constant.source: heavy 4-blade propeller and a carburetted twin: slower than the .61 glow's 0.25 s

propeller.name: 4-blade 26x12 (scale-look choice; DA-120 lists 3-blade 26x12 / 27x12)
propeller.rotation: clockwise seen from behind (standard tractor): the reaction torque rolls the airplane left

ct_table.source: research/p51/p51-05/derive_physics.py: blade-element/momentum theory, Prandtl tip loss, geometric pitch twist, generic section (a0 0.9x2pi, alpha_zl -3 deg, Cl caps +1.2/-0.8, Cd 0.012 + 0.025 Cl2 + post-stall rise); tabulated into the windmilling branch

rotating_inertia.source: 4 blades as slender rods + aluminium spinner

thrust_line_offset.source: research/p51/p51-05/derive_physics.py: spinner axis relative to the inventory CG; [x_aft, y_right, z_up] from the CG
